response.text: {"messages":[{"role":"customer","text":"hello there, hope u r having a good day"},{"role":"business","text":"hi! thanks, you too :) what can we get started for you?"},{"role":"customer","text":"i'd like that thing from before pls, 3 of them"},{"role":"business","text":"happy to help! which item was it? we've got a few burgers on the menu"},{"role":"customer","text":"oh sorry, the veggie burger. 3 of those pls"},{"role":"business","text":"got it, 3 veggie burgers. anything else?"},{"role":"customer","text":"quick q - does the veggie burger come with cheese already or is that extra"},{"role":"business","text":"it comes with lettuce, tomato, onions, pickles and mayo - american cheese is an add-on if you want it"},{"role":"customer","text":"thx for clearing that up. no cheese then. also a strawberry milkshake, a coke and a lemonade pls"},{"role":"business","text":"sounds good! delivery or pickup?"},{"role":"customer","text":"delivery pls to 36 dover terrace # 15. gonna pay by card"},{"role":"business","text":"perfect, so that's 3 veggie burgers, 1 strawberry milkshake, 1 coke and 1 lemonade, delivered to 36 Dover Terrace #15, paying by card. all correct?"},{"role":"customer","text":"yes thats right, thank u so much!"}]}
